notes.title: Full release of Desecrators out now!
notes.content:
Version 1.0 is finally here! It was a long and interesting ride. A huge thanks to all our Early Access players!

We are very excited to enter this new phase!

[b]Note: This version is incompatible with saves from previous versions![/b]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Galatic Treasury:
- New final level
- A new anomaly signature has been detected...
[*]Gauntlet mode option added:
- No resurrectors
- No saves
- More relics
[*]New game menu reworked:
- Added additional details for difficulty options
[*]Mission end and run end screens reworked:
- Displays individual stats for all players
- Added additional feedback
- Looks cooler
[*]Rebalanced rivals:
- Increased health
- Slightly lowered overall damage
- Reduced secondary reload rate
- Dodging pattern is now less jittery and more predictable
- Removed bonus move speed and turn rate on Hazard 4/5
- Rival spawning now has a short delay (similar to other enemies)
[*]Enemies health scaling now also reduces knockback they receive from damage
[*]Enemies reaction time is more forgiving for players entering rooms
[*]Reduced health of all Chamo enemies
[*]Stingers are now more aggresive when player has low health or when attacking from behind
[*]Increased Mega Mine Layer pickup drop count
[*]Turrets are now less likely to spawn near room entrances
[*]Multi-tile room entrances can now be fitted with doors and projectile traps
[*]Phantom Walls now sometimes have a random activation delay
[*]Enemies are now doubly affected by meltdown shake forces
[*]Duplicate weapon pickups can now increase ammo above normal limit
[*]Weapon upgrades can now be previewed when player does not have enough credits
[/list]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*]Weapon slots reworked:
- Can no longer be purchased with credits
- Now instead uses 'weapon slot' points
- Weapon slot points can be found as pickups in levels
- Increased max weapon slots 3 -> 4
[*]Bubblebomb is now proximity fused (projectile will detonate when close to enemies)
[*]Pillager now disarms and destroys mines on impact (kills mines without detonating them)
[*]Enemies now always drop max number of pickups when pillagede
[*]Bladder Mine fragments are now hydrodynamic (less affeced by underwater friction)
[*]Reduced Banshee fire rate and move speed
[*]Reduced Beehive fragment turn rate 200 -> 170
[*]Increased Impulse ammo cost 5/7/9 -> 5/8/11
[*]Increased Autopulser ammo cost 5/5.5/6 -> 5.5/6/6.5
[*]Increased Ack-Am damage 66/74/82 -> 70/80/90
[*]Increased Foamphase damage 60/66/72 -> 60/70/80
[*]Reduced Foamphase projectile speed 240 -> 230
[*]Reduced Ack-Am projectile speed 300 -> 250
[/list]

[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reworked view animations:
- Update all weapon recoil animations
- Adjusted weapon movement sway animation
- Improved weapon knockback animation
- Remastered all screenshake effects
[*]Added new move animations for Orca
[*]Improved player and rival engine FX
[*]Updated Thermo model
[*]Removed Halloween main menu decorations
[*]Improved graphics for HUD lock indicators
[*]Improved enemy spawning FX
[*]Adjusted Kraken, Autopulser and Multipine impact FX for better visibility
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reworked underwater sound mixing:
- Increased audible range of all sounds 
- Improved mixing for occluded sounds
- Underwater-specific are now less muffled
[*]Improved Bubblebomb firing sound
[*]Improved Multipine firing sound
[*]Improved Pyro and Plasma firing sounds
[*]Improved Mega Mine detonation sound
[*]Improved breakable destruction sounds
[*]Added audio feedback for Exopod loss
[*]Added activation sound for enemy generators
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added missing Exopod Swarm database description
[*]Fixed some enemy database descriptions still referencing Mine Ammo pickups
[*]Fixed Pillager autoselect priority being higher than intended
[*]Fixed weapon wheel being able to stay open during dropship sequences
[*]Fixed rare game freeze that could occur when a respawning player triggered a phantom wall
[*]Fixed player not being able to use exopod pickups to repair existing pods when ship was at max number of exopods
[*]Fixed weapon ammo bars sometimes getting stuck
[*]Fixed Smartbomb shockwave sometimes not dealing damage
[/list]

notes.title: 0.9.9e changelist
notes.content:
This update contains the beta branch changes, which have been tested and refined over the past few weeks.

Thanks to everyone who contributed feedback.

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*]Maximum weapon slots reduced 4 -> 3
[*]Removed Mine Ammo pickup
[*]Secondary Ammo pickup reworked
- Renamed to Munition Ammo
- Adds equal ammo for both secondaries and mines
[*]Increased mine launch invulnerability time 0.375s -> 0.425s
[*]Added Kraken secondary
[*]Adjusted Hoplite
- Damage increased 64 -> 72
- Max ammo increased 12 -> 16
- Ammo rate increased 3 -> 4
[*]Adjusted Cycler
- Damage per shot increased 12/8/8.5 -> 12/9/9.5
[*]Adjusted Piranha
- Ammo rate reduced 15 -> 10
[*]Adjusted Thermo
- Ammo rate reduced 0.5 -> 0.375
[*]Adjusted Ion Ray
- Ammo cost increased 12/15/18 -> 16/20/24
[*]Adjusted Foamphase
- Ammo cost increased 32/48/64 -> 32/64/80
[*]Adjusted Ack-Am
- Ammo cost increased 36/52/72 -> 40/80/96
[*]Adjusted Bladder Mine
- Increased fragment turn rate 136 -> 154
- Reworked movement pattern
[/list]
[h3]Artifacts[/h3]
[list]
[*]Ammo Modules reworked:
- No longer increases all ammo gained from pickups
- Now increases primary ammo gained from pickups by 50%
[*]Sensor Fuser now improves weapon tracking vs. cloaked enemies
[*]Increased Superpod hull 96 -> 128
[/list]
[h3]Pickups[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added dynamic pickup spawn/drop rates:
- Affects shield, fuel and ammo pickups
- Now partially selects pickups based on player state and other nearby pickups
- Will avoid duplicates or pickups the player cannot use
- Enemies will drop more pickups when player is low on resources
- Breakables (e.g. crates and barrels) will now always drop at least 1 pickup
[*]Reworked weapon pickup spawning
- Now takes current player loadout into account
- Now takes all previously dropped weapons of the run into account
- Now selects a roughly equal distribution of primaries, secondaries and mines
- Reduced overall weapon drop/spawn rate
[*]Reworked exopod droprate to be more consistent
[*]Removed bonus lives earned from credits
[*]Reworked Resurrector spawning
- No longer limited to secrets
- Now more likely to spawn when players are out of lives
[*]Added Mega Shield pickup

notes.title: Desecrators 0.9.5 - Polystate
notes.content:
Desecrators 0.9.5 features co-op changes, a new title screen and multiple save slots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40052107/6051b31bd28cd0c1a06ad4cf59bb187774cb0d23.png[/img]

When launching Desecrators after the update it will attempt to migrate your existing game save into save slot 1. 
[list]
[*] For singleplayer you should be able to continue your game seamlessly.
[*] For multiplayer, please be aware that client loadouts are not migrated. Instead, the first time a player joins a specific game they will start with the default loadout and their progress will only be persisted on the server.
[/list]
